test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. CV Raman’s story begins in a village near Tiruchirapalli (known in his days as Trichinopoly) in southern India.

P. When he was four years old, Raman’s family moved to Vishakapatnam.

Q. He was born on 8 November 1888, the second child of R Chandrashekara Iyer and Parvati Ammal.

R. Chandrasekara Iyer was an athletic man and he took active interest in sports.

S. His father took up a job there, as a lecturer in Mrs. AV Narsimha Rao College, where he taught physics, mathematics and physical geography.

S6. His young son Raman was not physically very strong, but was very intelligent and he preferred to read books and work at his studies.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing CV Raman's early life in a specific location, setting the context for his background.
 
• **Sentence Q is the second sentence** as it provides the birth details of CV Raman:
 
 
• "He was born on 8 November 1888, the second child of R Chandrashekara Iyer and Parvati Ammal."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P follows** as it details a significant move in his early childhood:
 
 
• "When he was four years old, Raman's family moved to Vishakapatnam."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the fourth sentence** because it explains the reason for the family's move:
 
 
• "His father took up a job there, as a lecturer in Mrs. AV Narsimha Rao College, where he taught physics, mathematics and physical geography."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the fifth** as it provides additional information about his father:
 
 
• "Chandrasekara Iyer was an athletic man and he took active interest in sports."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QPSR**.
